body:
Hi Dan,

I was on your website this week and had to scroll the entire page before I found your phone number. It sits right at the bottom, under everything. A Tallahassee homeowner with ants in the kitchen or a termite question is not going to scroll that far. They will call the company whose number is at the top.

The rest of the page works hard but says very little. You list three services, and each one gets only a few words: Year-Round Coverage, Wood Damage Reports, Structural Damage Defense. After 35 years in pest control, the site never says what a visit includes or why anyone should pick you.

So I designed a new homepage for Graham Pest Management, and it is attached to this email as a PDF. Your number sits at the top where it belongs, your services get real descriptions, your WDO and termite work has room to breathe, and your customer reviews are front and center.

I built the site for EcoLa Termite (ecolatermite.com), a termite and pest company, around clear services and fast contact. Find Pest Pros (orkin.findpestpros.com) is a pest control site I worked on that turns local searches into calls.

If you like the direction, I can build it for real on your own domain. If not, keep the PDF as free ideas.

Best,
Hassan
name: Graham Pest Management
subject: 🐜 Dan, your phone number hides at the bottom of the page
